mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy shift that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market with unemployment below 4.0% and job growth exceeding 150k, the risk of overheating and monetary tightening increases, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 150k, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1900 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST < 1900 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates persistent inflation requiring monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS stable or rises
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS stable or rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% (GDPC1), the risk of policy-induced slowdown increases, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 > 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
